//: W1-T3177: BROWSER-SHAPED, and deliberately not an extension of the repo root's config.
The root is Node-shaped -- module/moduleResolution nodenext, types [node], no jsx -- and this
is a browser SPA: bundler resolution (Vite owns resolution, not tsc), jsx react-jsx (the
runtime transform, so no React import per file) and vite/client types for import.meta.env.
Those two sets cannot be one config, which is why the root's `apps/*/src/**/*.ts` include was
removed in the same change: with it, the root run typechecked this tree under Node rules and
noEmit: Vite emits the bundle. tsc here is a TYPE GATE only -- an outDir would put a second,
unreferenced copy of the tree beside the real build.
src/main.ts (dashboard v0) is EXCLUDED rather than deleted: it is the pre-React shell, it does
not compile under bundler resolution (it resolves @remudero/api-client/client through a
package exports map tsc will not read here), and the strangler ruling says the thing being
replaced is not deleted by the task that replaces it. Nothing imports it; it is archived in
place, and removing it is a later parity task.
